title: Prospective evidence-dependent Hindi/Punjabi pronunciation-to-rhythm alignment test

evidence_gate.not_ready: Missing genuine verified pronunciation alternatives and independent syllable boundaries

primary_question: Under independently established phonological candidate sets, how often does top-1 early commitment report formal infeasibility when an independent reference considers an alternative candidate admissible?
blocking_design_rule: The evaluator and its gold labels cannot be generated from the same phonological hypothesis under test
statistical_plan: Report exact numerators and denominators, confidence intervals with word or source clusters when applicable, and no confirmatory claims if external benchmarks are insufficient
